lines: See what's new in each AnimalTown update.
The version file records four lines for each request.
The release combines the new requests into one brief summary.
The published release includes the summary alongside its downloads.
See how much time is left on your update download.
The updater shows the estimated time beneath the progress bar.
The countdown follows recent transfer speed and clears on a stall.
The screen reports verification and restart once the download finishes.
